steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the test.
Publish the configured event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Accept the required clause.
Accept the optional clause as required by the case.
Verify the required clause remains visible after acceptance.
Verify the optional clause remains visible after acceptance.
Submit the vendor's Technical-stage response with both clauses accepted.
Confirm the Technical-stage response was submitted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the Technical-stage-only clause is not requested on RFQ.
Verify the second Technical-stage-only clause is not requested on RFQ.
Quote 100 for the RFQ line item and submit the bid.
Confirm the vendor's RFQ bid was submitted.
